opinions: I BELIEVE THAT PEOPLE'S SEXUAL ORIENTATIONS ARE NATURALLY OCCURRING AND SHOULD BE RESPECTED AND ACCEPTED.
I THINK THAT ABORTION SHOULD BE A SAFE AND ACCESSIBLE OPTION FOR WOMEN, AND THAT IT'S NOT THE GOVERNMENT'S PLACE TO DICTATE THEIR REPRODUCTIVE CHOICES.
I AGREE THAT THERE ARE ONLY DIFFERENT CULTURES, AND THAT NO CULTURE IS INHERENTLY SUPERIOR TO ANOTHER.
I BELIEVE THAT OUR CIVIL LIBERTIES ARE BEING ERODED IN THE NAME OF COUNTER-TERRORISM, AND THAT THIS IS A DANGEROUS TREND.
I THINK THAT CHILDREN SHOULD BE ABLE TO HAVE SOME PRIVACY AND AUTONOMY, AND THAT IT'S NOT NECESSARY FOR PARENTS TO KNOW EVERYTHING.
I DISAGREE THAT A COMPLETELY FREE MARKET IS THE BEST WAY TO ENSURE FREEDOM FOR PEOPLE, AS IT CAN LEAD TO EXPLOITATION AND INEQUALITY.
I THINK THAT COMPULSORY CLASSROOM ATTENDANCE CAN BE BENEFICIAL FOR CHILDREN'S EDUCATION AND SOCIAL DEVELOPMENT.
I BELIEVE THAT SPANKING IS NOT AN EFFECTIVE OR ACCEPTABLE WAY TO DISCIPLINE CHILDREN, AND THAT IT CAN BE HARMFUL.
I AGREE THAT A GENUINE FREE MARKET REQUIRES REGULATIONS TO PREVENT MONOPOLIES AND PROTECT CONSUMERS.
I THINK THAT ECONOMIC GLOBALIZATION SHOULD PRIORITIZE THE NEEDS OF PEOPLE AND THE ENVIRONMENT OVER CORPORATE PROFITS.
I BELIEVE THAT THE RICH SHOULD BE TAXED AT A HIGHER RATE TO REDUCE INCOME INEQUALITY AND FUND SOCIAL PROGRAMS.
I THINK THAT PEOPLE WHO ARE ABLE TO WORK BUT REFUSE TO DO SO SHOULD STILL BE SUPPORTED BY SOCIETY, AS EVERYONE DESERVES A SAFETY NET.
I DISAGREE THAT SEX OUTSIDE OF MARRIAGE IS USUALLY IMMORAL, AS PEOPLE HAVE THE RIGHT TO MAKE THEIR OWN CHOICES ABOUT THEIR RELATIONSHIPS.
I BELIEVE THAT AUTHORITY SHOULD BE QUESTIONED AND HELD ACCOUNTABLE, AS THIS IS AN IMPORTANT PART OF A HEALTHY DEMOCRACY.
I THINK THAT PUBLIC FUNDING FOR THE ARTS IS IMPORTANT FOR PRESERVING CULTURE AND PROMOTING CREATIVITY.
I DISAGREE THAT BUSINESSPEOPLE AND MANUFACTURERS ARE MORE IMPORTANT THAN WRITERS AND ARTISTS, AS ALL PROFESSIONS HAVE VALUE.
I BELIEVE THAT MAKING PEACE WITH THE ESTABLISHMENT IS NOT ALWAYS THE BEST APPROACH, AS IT CAN INVOLVE COMPROMISING ONE'S VALUES.
I AGREE THAT CORPORATIONS NEED TO BE REGULATED TO PROTECT THE ENVIRONMENT AND PUBLIC HEALTH.
I THINK THAT THE IDEA OF 'FROM EACH ACCORDING TO THEIR ABILITY, TO EACH ACCORDING TO THEIR NEED' IS A GOOD PRINCIPLE FOR CREATING A MORE EQUAL SOCIETY.
I BELIEVE THAT THE DEATH PENALTY IS NOT AN EFFECTIVE OR JUST WAY TO PUNISH CRIMES, AND THAT IT SHOULD BE ABOLISHED.
I AGREE THAT BUSINESSES THAT MISLEAD THE PUBLIC SHOULD BE PENALIZED, AS THIS IS A FORM OF FRAUD.
I THINK THAT PORNOGRAPHY DEPICTING CONSENTING ADULTS SHOULD BE LEGAL, AS PEOPLE HAVE THE RIGHT TO MAKE THEIR OWN CHOICES ABOUT WHAT THEY WATCH.
I BELIEVE THAT ECONOMIC GROWTH IS NOT SUSTAINABLE IN THE LONG TERM, AND THAT WE NEED TO PRIORITIZE ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION AND SOCIAL WELFARE.
I DISAGREE THAT PEOPLE SHOULD BE SEPARATED BY THEIR DIFFERENCES, AS THIS CAN LEAD TO DISCRIMINATION AND INEQUALITY.
I THINK THAT REHABILITATION IS AN IMPORTANT GOAL OF THE CRIMINAL JUSTICE SYSTEM, AND THAT IT'S NOT A WASTE OF TIME TO TRY TO REHABILITATE OFFENDERS.
I BELIEVE THAT A CIVILIZED SOCIETY SHOULD PRIORITIZE EQUALITY AND MUTUAL RESPECT, RATHER THAN OBEDIENCE AND COMMAND.
I AGREE THAT ONLY WRONGDOERS NEED TO BE WORRIED ABOUT OFFICIAL SURVEILLANCE, BUT I ALSO THINK THAT SURVEILLANCE CAN BE USED TO TARGET MARGINALIZED GROUPS.
I DISAGREE THAT OPENNESS ABOUT SEX HAS GONE TOO FAR, AS PEOPLE HAVE THE RIGHT TO MAKE THEIR OWN CHOICES ABOUT THEIR RELATIONSHIPS AND BODIES.
I THINK THAT PEOPLE'S FORTUNES ARE NOT SOLELY DETERMINED BY LUCK, BUT ALSO BY THEIR CIRCUMSTANCES AND THE OPPORTUNITIES AVAILABLE TO THEM.
I BELIEVE THAT ASTROLOGY IS NOT A SCIENTIFICALLY SUPPORTED WAY OF UNDERSTANDING THE WORLD, AND THAT IT SHOULD NOT BE USED TO MAKE IMPORTANT DECISIONS.
I DISAGREE THAT PEOPLE WHO CAN AFFORD TO PAY FOR HIGHER STANDARDS OF MEDICAL CARE SHOULD HAVE PRIORITY ACCESS, AS THIS CAN LEAD TO HEALTH INEQUALITIES.
I THINK THAT PEOPLE WITH SERIOUS INHERITABLE DISABILITIES SHOULD HAVE THE RIGHT TO MAKE THEIR OWN REPRODUCTIVE CHOICES, AND THAT THEY SHOULD NOT BE DISCRIMINATED AGAINST.
I BELIEVE THAT CLASS IS AN IMPORTANT FACTOR IN SHAPING PEOPLE'S EXPERIENCES AND OPPORTUNITIES, AND THAT IT CAN BE MORE SIGNIFICANT THAN NATIONALITY.
I AGREE THAT WHAT GOES ON IN A PRIVATE BEDROOM BETWEEN CONSENTING ADULTS IS NO BUSINESS OF THE STATE, AS PEOPLE HAVE THE RIGHT TO MAKE THEIR OWN CHOICES ABOUT THEIR RELATIONSHIPS.
I DISAGREE THAT FIRST-GENERATION IMMIGRANTS CAN NEVER BE FULLY INTEGRATED INTO THEIR NEW COUNTRY, AS THIS CAN LEAD TO DISCRIMINATION AND EXCLUSION.
I BELIEVE THAT THE IDEA OF RACIAL SUPERIORITY IS NOT SUPPORTED BY SCIENCE, AND THAT IT IS A HARMFUL AND DISCRIMINATORY IDEOLOGY.
I THINK THAT MOTHERS SHOULD HAVE THE RIGHT TO PURSUE CAREERS AND MAKE THEIR OWN CHOICES ABOUT THEIR WORK AND FAMILY LIFE.
I DISAGREE THAT THE MOST IMPORTANT THING FOR CHILDREN TO LEARN IS TO ACCEPT DISCIPLINE, AS THIS CAN LEAD TO OBEDIENCE WITHOUT CRITICAL THINKING OR AUTONOMY.
I BELIEVE THAT SOCIAL SECURITY IS A MORE EFFECTIVE AND SUSTAINABLE WAY OF HELPING THE GENUINELY DISADVANTAGED THAN CHARITY, AS IT PROVIDES A SAFETY NET AND PROMOTES ECONOMIC EQUALITY.
I AGREE THAT IT IS REGRETTABLE THAT SOME PEOPLE MAKE FORTUNES BY MANIPULATING MONEY AND CONTRIBUTING NOTHING TO SOCIETY, AS THIS CAN LEAD TO ECONOMIC INEQUALITY AND EXPLOITATION.
I THINK THAT MILITARY ACTION SHOULD ALWAYS BE SUBJECT TO INTERNATIONAL LAW AND HUMAN RIGHTS STANDARDS, AND THAT IT SHOULD NOT BE USED AS A FIRST RESORT.
I BELIEVE THAT LAND SHOULD BE USED FOR THE BENEFIT OF ALL PEOPLE, RATHER THAN BEING TREATED AS A COMMODITY TO BE BOUGHT AND SOLD.
I DISAGREE THAT SCHOOLS SHOULD INSTILL RELIGIOUS VALUES, AS THIS CAN LEAD TO INDOCTRINATION AND EXCLUSION OF PEOPLE FROM DIFFERENT BACKGROUNDS.
I THINK THAT CONTROLLING UNEMPLOYMENT IS MORE IMPORTANT THAN CONTROLLING INFLATION, AS UNEMPLOYMENT CAN HAVE A MORE SIGNIFICANT IMPACT ON PEOPLE'S LIVES AND WELL-BEING.
I BELIEVE THAT MORALITY IS NOT DEPENDENT ON RELIGION, AND THAT PEOPLE CAN BE MORAL AND ETHICAL WITHOUT BEING RELIGIOUS.
I DISAGREE THAT THE PRIME FUNCTION OF SCHOOLING SHOULD BE TO EQUIP THE FUTURE GENERATION TO FIND JOBS, AS EDUCATION SHOULD ALSO PROMOTE CRITICAL THINKING, CREATIVITY, AND SOCIAL RESPONSIBILITY.
I THINK THAT THE IDEA THAT 'THE ENEMY OF MY ENEMY IS MY FRIEND' IS NOT ALWAYS TRUE, AND THAT ALLIANCES SHOULD BE BASED ON SHARED VALUES AND PRINCIPLES RATHER THAN CONVENIENCE OR EXPEDIENCY.
I BELIEVE THAT PUBLIC FUNDING FOR BROADCASTING INSTITUTIONS IS IMPORTANT FOR PROMOTING DIVERSITY, QUALITY, AND ACCESSIBILITY OF MEDIA CONTENT.
I DISAGREE THAT THE ONLY SOCIAL RESPONSIBILITY OF A COMPANY IS TO DELIVER A PROFIT TO ITS SHAREHOLDERS, AS COMPANIES ALSO HAVE A RESPONSIBILITY TO THEIR EMPLOYEES, CUSTOMERS, AND THE WIDER COMMUNITY.
I THINK THAT WHEN PEOPLE ARE TROUBLED, IT'S OFTEN HELPFUL TO TALK ABOUT THEIR PROBLEMS AND SEEK SUPPORT, RATHER THAN JUST KEEPING BUSY WITH MORE CHEERFUL THINGS.
I BELIEVE THAT BLIND PATRIOTISM IS NOT A VIRTUE, AND THAT PEOPLE SHOULD CRITICALLY EVALUATE THEIR COUNTRY'S ACTIONS AND POLICIES.
I AGREE THAT SAME-SEX COUPLES IN STABLE, LOVING RELATIONSHIPS SHOULD BE ABLE TO ADOPT CHILDREN, AS THIS IS A MATTER OF EQUALITY AND HUMAN RIGHTS.
I THINK THAT IT'S A SAD REFLECTION ON OUR SOCIETY THAT SOMETHING AS BASIC AS DRINKING WATER IS NOW A BOTTLED, BRANDED CONSUMER PRODUCT, AS THIS CAN LEAD TO EXPLOITATION AND ENVIRONMENTAL DEGRADATION.
I BELIEVE THAT POSSESSING MARIJUANA FOR PERSONAL USE SHOULD NOT BE A CRIMINAL OFFENSE, AS THIS CAN LEAD TO UNNECESSARY HARM AND INJUSTICE.
I AGREE THAT PROTECTIONISM CAN BE NECESSARY IN TRADE, AS IT CAN HELP TO PROTECT DOMESTIC INDUSTRIES AND WORKERS FROM UNFAIR COMPETITION.
I DISAGREE THAT WHAT'S GOOD FOR THE MOST SUCCESSFUL CORPORATIONS IS ALWAYS GOOD FOR ALL OF US, AS THIS CAN LEAD TO EXPLOITATION AND INEQUALITY.
I THINK THAT THE IDEA OF 'AN EYE FOR AN EYE AND A TOOTH FOR A TOOTH' IS NOT A JUST OR EFFECTIVE WAY OF PUNISHING CRIMES, AS IT CAN LEAD TO ENDLESS CYCLES OF VIOLENCE AND RETALIATION.
I BELIEVE THAT A ONE-PARTY STATE IS NOT A DEMOCRATIC OR DESIRABLE FORM OF GOVERNMENT, AS IT CAN LEAD TO AUTHORITARIANISM AND HUMAN RIGHTS ABUSES.
I DISAGREE THAT ABSTRACT ART IS NOT 'REAL' ART, AS ART IS A DIVERSE AND SUBJECTIVE FIELD THAT CAN TAKE MANY DIFFERENT FORMS.
I THINK THAT PEOPLE SHOULD BE PROUD OF THEIR CULTURAL HERITAGE AND NATIONAL IDENTITY, BUT ALSO RECOGNIZE THE VALUE OF DIVERSITY AND GLOBAL CITIZENSHIP.
I BELIEVE THAT REHABILITATION SHOULD BE A KEY GOAL OF THE CRIMINAL JUSTICE SYSTEM, RATHER THAN PUNISHMENT, AS THIS CAN HELP TO REDUCE RECIDIVISM AND PROMOTE COMMUNITY SAFETY.
I AGREE THAT THERE IS A WORRYING FUSION OF INFORMATION AND ENTERTAINMENT, AS THIS CAN LEAD TO THE SPREAD OF MISINFORMATION AND THE EROSION OF CRITICAL THINKING SKILLS.
